aboutMe.betterHorizonText:
One of my most important values is self-improvement. Learning is a passion of mine, and I apply that knowledge to find creative and logical solutions in everyday challenges.
While I approach work with seriousness and responsibility, I like to find joy in small moments, hence the whimsical nature of this portfolio.
aboutMe.whyJapanText:
Although I do love sushi, anime, and games, Japan has always resonated with my heart.
I deeply appreciate the warmth and consideration evident in daily interactions in this country - small acts of acknowledgement, such as realizing a place is too crowded and narrow, and bowing slightly when meeting someone else in your path.
I'm also quite aligned with Ganbarimasu, a very common word in Japanese that means doing your best. I'm honored and grateful to live in this country, and if it all goes well, this is where I hope to settle for the long run.
aboutMe.professionalAchievementsText: In my 12 years of frontend and full stack experience, I have developed from scratch, refactored and maintained:
achievements: Real-time data dashboards, including graphs, maps, tables and filters
API Integrations, including from internal and external SDKS, as well as handling documentation
Responsive design and functionality including media streaming for all kinds of devices and browsers, even Smart TVs
Multi-language projects, implementation of authentication and different levels of authorization, testing, deploying
aboutMe.achievementsConclusion: I have also mentored junior engineers, conducted interviews for senior positions, and implemented a components library for internal use.
aboutMe.softSkillsText: Coming from a communicative culture and having lived in the multicultural environment that is Berlin, I navigate the nuances of talking to people from different countries with ease. I can translate technical concepts for stakeholders, collaborate with interns, align with leads, speak to the boss and communicate to the customer. My personality is action-oriented, I constantly identify what needs to be done and I ensure timely execution.
aboutMe.JapaneseLevelText: To practice my Japanese speaking abilities, I work part-time at an Izakaya. The first days presented a steep challenge, but I quickly adapted by focusing on essential vocabulary required for the environment. I'm sure something similar will apply if I work in Japanese in an office. Although I'm not yet fluent, I'm adaptable and a good communicator, and I'll continue to make use of that Ganbarimasu to ensure I can speak as smoothly as my colleagues.
